purpose: Define row/record-level visibility as an explicit predicate over exact fields, identity/session/context refs and governed policy inputs, applied before result exposure.

value.predicate_rule: Record-scope predicate is explicit machine-readable policy semantics.
value.context_rule: Caller/session/identity/project/peer context refs are explicit inputs where used.
value.filter_rule: Records failing the scope predicate are excluded from the authorized projection.
value.query_rule: Query filters do not substitute for governance filters; both are evaluated independently.
value.join_rule: Joining data cannot expand record visibility beyond each contributing source's governed scope.
value.unknown_rule: Unknown predicate result follows explicit fail-closed policy for protected data.
value.authority_rule: Record-scope match is not itself AccessCore authorization.
